analysis: {'Project A': {'Clarity of Value Proposition': '• Strong – Clearly articulates a need for verifiable provenance and addresses skepticism around digital authenticity. The survey proposal is a good start but needs more detail.', 'Feasibility and Development Plan': '• Moderate – The core concept is feasible, but the phased approach and reliance on widgets and community witnesses introduce complexity. The focus on a single standard initially is smart.', 'Revenue Model and Sustainability': '• Good – Transaction-based model is logical and adaptable.
